Emerging Trends in EV Charger Installation and Infrastructure

Introduction

The electric vehicle (EV) revolution is accelerating at an unprecedented pace, driven by environmental concerns, government incentives, and consumer demand. As a leading electrical and general contractor in Los Angeles, Shaffer Construction, Inc. specializes in installing EV chargers and their essential infrastructure, helping property owners and businesses transition to a sustainable future. With the EV market expanding rapidly, staying informed about the latest industry developments is crucial for making smart investment decisions. In this blog post, we explore key trends and innovations shaping the EV charging landscape, drawing insights from recent news and how they relate to the services we provide. From advanced software solutions to enhanced security measures and funding opportunities, understanding these elements can ensure that your EV charger installations are efficient, secure, and future-proof.

Software Solutions for Enhanced EV Charger Management

One of the most significant advancements in EV charging infrastructure is the integration of cloud-based software platforms that streamline management and improve user experience. For example, Sheetz has partnered with Vontier to adopt the Driivz platform, which enables remote, real-time troubleshooting of charger issues. This system also offers features like loyalty rewards, session tracking, and digital receipts, reducing downtime and enhancing customer satisfaction. For property owners, this means lower maintenance costs and increased reliability. At Shaffer Construction, we recognize the value of such technologies and can incorporate similar software solutions into your EV charger installations. Whether for commercial properties, multifamily residences, or public sites, integrating smart management systems ensures that your charging stations operate smoothly, provide valuable data insights, and adapt to evolving needs without requiring constant on-site attention.

Addressing Security Concerns with GPS Tracking

Security is a top priority in EV charger installations, as incidents like cable theft can lead to significant downtime, repair expenses, and user frustration. InstaVolt has launched a GPS tracking system to combat EV charger cable theft, using real-time technology to detect, trace, and recover stolen cables. This approach not only minimizes losses but also speeds up the process of bringing chargers back online, as damaged units often require recertification. For clients in Los Angeles and beyond, Shaffer Construction emphasizes secure installations by recommending and implementing anti-theft measures, such as robust locking mechanisms and surveillance integration. By staying ahead of security challenges, we help protect your investment and ensure that your EV charging infrastructure remains operational and trustworthy, supporting broader adoption and user confidence.

Investment and Funding for EV Infrastructure

The expansion of EV charging networks relies heavily on accessible funding and strategic investments. An investment platform launched in France by TotalEnergies and Banque des Territoires aims to accelerate EV charger rollout in municipalities, focusing on developing, operating, and maintaining public charging infrastructure powered by renewable energy. This model highlights the growing global emphasis on public-private partnerships to meet net-zero goals. In the U.S., similar initiatives are emerging, offering grants and incentives for EV charger installations. Shaffer Construction can guide property owners through these opportunities, helping identify funding sources, navigate application processes, and design cost-effective solutions that align with local regulations and sustainability targets. By leveraging financial support, businesses and communities can reduce upfront costs and accelerate their transition to electric mobility, with our expertise ensuring that installations are compliant, efficient, and scalable.

Leadership and Expansion in Charging Networks

The growth of EV charging networks is fueled by strong leadership and ambitious expansion plans, which in turn drive demand for reliable installation services. Ionna has appointed Seth Cutler, former chief engineer of Electrify America, as CEO, with plans to install at least 30,000 EV chargers across North America. This scale of deployment underscores the importance of partnering with experienced contractors who can handle complex installations, from site assessment to grid integration. At Shaffer Construction, we have the skills and resources to support large-scale projects, ensuring that chargers are installed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with electrical codes. Whether you’re a developer, municipality, or business owner, our team can manage every aspect of the installation process, from permitting to final testing, helping you contribute to the expanding EV ecosystem while minimizing disruptions and maximizing ROI.

Technological Advancements in Charging Systems

Innovation in charging hardware is essential to meet the growing demands for faster and more flexible EV charging. Siemens has unveiled the Sicharge Flex, a next-generation EV charging system designed for the megawatt era, featuring industry-leading power density and adaptable dispenser options. This technology supports high-power applications, such as fleet charging and public fast-charging hubs, and is built for scalability and reliability. As installers, Shaffer Construction stays at the forefront of these advancements, offering clients access to cutting-edge equipment that future-proofs their investments. We assess site-specific needs—whether for residential, commercial, or industrial settings—and recommend solutions that optimize performance, energy efficiency, and compatibility with emerging standards. By embracing technological progress, we help ensure that your EV charging infrastructure not only meets current needs but also adapts to future innovations in electric mobility.

Conclusion

The evolution of EV charger installation and infrastructure is marked by exciting developments in software, security, funding, and technology. These trends highlight the importance of working with a knowledgeable partner who can integrate the latest solutions into your projects.
